## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

RecordedRaceListenerService — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/sync/RecordedRaceListenerService.kt

## Trigger

Receiving a `/recorded-race` message from the watch, in `onMessageReceived` — observed

## Today

`EndOfRaceViewModel.init` (app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/endofrace/EndOfRaceViewModel.kt)
calls `ProfileRepository.updateCorrectionFactor` with `finalRace.retainedFactors`'s
last entry's `factor`, overwriting the watch's own `Profile.correctionFactor`
at the end of each recorded race.

`RecordedRaceSyncService` then sends that race to the phone as a
`RecordedRacePayload(raceId, name, date, segments, completion)` — no
`retainedFactors` or `rejectedCalibrations` field. `RecordedRaceListenerService.onMessageReceived`
decodes it and calls `RaceRepository.saveRecordedRace(payload.raceId, payload.name,
payload.date, payload.segments, payload.completion)`; `RaceRepositoryImpl
.saveRecordedRace` (core-data/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/data/race/RaceRepositoryImpl.kt)
builds the stored `Race` with `retainedFactors = emptyList()` and
`rejectedCalibrations = emptyList()` unconditionally — the watch's computed
values never reach the phone's stored race, and nothing on `:app-phone`
calls `ProfileRepository.updateCorrectionFactor`.

`ProfileSyncPushService.push` (core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/domain/sync/ProfileSyncPushService.kt)
reads the phone's own `Profile` via `profileRepository.observe().first()`
and sends it as-is on the next established link (via `ProfileViewModel`'s
`onSyncClicked` or its `LinkStateMonitor.observeLinkEstablished()` collector).
`ProfileSyncListenerService.applyIncoming` on the watch then calls
`ProfileRepository.updateCorrectionFactor(profile.correctionFactor)`
(`ProfileSyncPushService.applyProfile`), overwriting the watch's own
factor with the phone's unchanged one — undoing what `EndOfRaceViewModel`
had computed there.

## Expected

Receiving a recorded race on the phone (`RecordedRaceListenerService
.onMessageReceived`, after `RaceRepository.saveRecordedRace` succeeds)
derives the phone's `correctionFactor` from that race's `retainedFactors`
— its last entry's `factor`, the same rule `EndOfRaceViewModel` applies
on the watch — and writes it via `ProfileRepository.updateCorrectionFactor`,
skipped when `retainedFactors` is empty. The next `ProfileSyncPushService
.push` then carries that updated value back down to the watch, so a race
recorded on the watch is no longer undone by the following sync.

Second gap — the data this fix needs does not cross the wire today:
`RecordedRacePayload` (core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/domain/sync/RecordedRacePayload.kt)
carries no `retainedFactors`; `RecordedRacePayloadSnapshot` and
`PayloadCodec.encode(RecordedRacePayload)`/`decodeRecordedRace`
(core-sync/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/sync/transport/PayloadCodec.kt)
mirror that same omission; `RaceRepository.saveRecordedRace`'s signature
(core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/domain/race/RaceRepository.kt,
implemented in `RaceRepositoryImpl.saveRecordedRace`) takes no
`retainedFactors`/`rejectedCalibrations` parameter and always persists
both as empty lists. All four have to carry `retainedFactors` (and,
for consistency with `Race`, `rejectedCalibrations`) before the bearer
can derive anything from them.
